name: spline-portfolio-app
description: Cinematic personal portfolio with Spline 3D room, eye-zoom transitions, and neon project showcase — built with React, Vite, and Framer Motion.

name: AI-Resume-Screener
description: NLP-powered resume screening tool that ranks candidates against job descriptions using TF-IDF and semantic similarity. Built with Python and Streamlit.

name: gesture-canvas
description: Real-time hand-gesture drawing canvas using MediaPipe hand tracking and OpenCV. Draw in the air — no touch required.

name: SmartBite
description: Nutrition-tracking web app that uses food image recognition to estimate macro content. React frontend with a FastAPI backend and a custom CNN model.

name: mini-shell
description: A tiny UNIX shell in C supporting piping, I/O redirection, background processes, and built-in commands — written from scratch as a systems project.

name: EchoBoard
description: Collaborative real-time whiteboard with voice annotation, built on WebSockets and React. Rooms are ephemeral and peer-to-peer via WebRTC.
